approved_scope.title: Fix 277
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-records-009 already says each bug becomes a Markdown bug and each carried observation becomes an entry or a receipt. The Log lines of a migrated bug named those observations by bare 0.5.x ID; they now link the file that holds each. No requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: A migrated bug's Log names each carried observation as a Markdown link, relative to the bug's file, to the open session's evidence entry or to the archived story that holds its receipt; every such link opens a file; a receipt only the bug holds is named as the bug's own; a removed observation keeps its 0.5.x ID. The bug's front matter is unchanged.
